name: Locker
summary: Drop a file into a parcel locker, lock it with a password, set an expiry and a download limit
about: A file share built as a wall of sky-blue lockers. Choose or drop a real file and it appears inside open locker 14, with a thumbnail for pictures. Set a password (a strength meter and the keypad react), an expiry and how many downloads; Lock & share swings the door shut, turns the handle and prints a link, while the screen above counts down. Delete or the last download opens the door and the file breaks apart.
how: Click the drop area to choose a file, or drag one onto it.
Type a password of at least 6 characters; the eye button shows or hides it.
Pick 1 hour, 1 day or 7 days and set the download limit with minus and plus.
Press Lock & share, then Copy the link.
Delete link (or running out of time or downloads) empties the locker.
